subject: design-technology
title: Isometric & Orthographic
welcome_lead: Two technical drawing styles every designer uses.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: isometric drawing and orthographic projections.
final_note: Technical drawings let anyone build your design.

concepts.def: Flat views of an object from each side.
Ratio of drawing to real size.

walkthroughs.body_html: Isometric drawings use vertical lines and two sets at 30 degrees from horizontal. Cubes drawn this way show three sides at once. Great for showing how a design looks in 3D.
Orthographic projection shows three flat views: plan (top), front elevation, side elevation. Together they let an engineer build the object precisely.
Drawings use a scale — 1:1 = real size, 1:2 = half size, 2:1 = double size. Always include the scale label so people know how big it really is.
